construction_prompt: A full-length, skin-tight latex catsuit with long fitted sleeves ending at the wrists and full-length legs ending at the ankles. It is made from glued sheet latex, not sewn fabric: the neckline is a simple low rounded opening cut directly through the latex sheet, and the wrists and ankles finish as simple open cut edges. There is no collar, cuffs, waistband, piping, folded or reinforced edges, zips, buttons, fasteners or decorative construction, and no visible stitching. Colour boundaries are changes of colour within one continuous latex surface, not raised panels or separate pieces.

shell.label: Outer sides
parts: broad outer areas on the outside of the arms, shoulder to wrist
broad outer areas on the outside of the legs, hip to ankle

accent.label: Divider stripe
parts: one narrow stripe between the outer sides and the central body, running down the outside of the arms and legs
